profiles.purpose: One bounded UI change with direct state/evidence checks.
One route or surface with stack, semantics, state and interaction evidence.
A form or multi-state user flow with local/API behavior and recovery.
A surface whose acceptance depends on native viewport and accessibility evidence.
Final builder-to-verifier handoff after a bounded repair cycle.

selection_rule: Select the smallest profile covering the frozen surface, state, interaction and evidence contract; never widen scope implicitly.
